svg.title: AI Engineering Roadmap
svg.desc: A skill-level curve from Python to LLMs to AI agents: Python, NumPy and Pandas, Math and Statistics, Git and GitHub, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, PyTorch, LLM APIs, Prompt Engineering, Embeddings, Vector Databases, RAG Pipelines, AI Agents, Evals and Guardrails, FastAPI Deploy. Four projects to build: Data Analysis Notebook, ML Prediction Model, RAG Chatbot, AI Agent App.
svg.text: From Python to LLMs to AI agents
